maint.note: YourMechanic: $78 average pad parts; front pad jobs $307-$317 (shops $349-$492). Rotors add to the cost.

maint.job: Rear brake pads (or shoes on early drum-brake cars)
maint.note: YourMechanic: rear pad jobs $307-$336 (shops $349-$501). Later models with an electronic parking brake need service mode.
YourMechanic: $315 average ($175 parts); $496-$509 for most model years (shops $585-$878). Auto start-stop models need an AGM battery.
Motorcraft plugs about $14 each (4 or 6 needed). On V6 models the rear plugs require removing the upper intake.
